result.document_summary: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board public notice announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment (AGA) of 1.0%, set at 65% of Bay Area CPI under Regulation 1148.
result.notes: Notice does not state building coverage or exemptions beyond the Costa-Hawkins tenancy carve-out (post-2025 tenancies with Costa-Hawkins-set rents are not adjusted). The notice gives no explicit effective date for the AGA formula itself; the 2026 Order allows increases no earlier than 2026-01-01.

rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (65% of CPI)
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% for 2026, no earlier than January 1, 2026; the AGA is set at 65% of the Bay Area CPI-U increase. The AGA does not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and had rents set under Costa-Hawkins.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110(A); Berkeley Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span: will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units subject to Berkeley rent stabilization where the landlord is eligible to take the AGA; the notice does not describe building-level coverage.

exemptions.label: Tenancies beginning on or after 2025-01-01 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins

all_of.value: tenancy began on or after 2025-01-01 with rent set pursuant to Costa-Hawkins
all_of.text: tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025, and had rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

rules.exemptions_text: The 2026 AGA may not adjust rents of tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.
rules.interaction: The notice references the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act as limiting the AGA for certain new tenancies, and Regulation 1148 sets the qualifying conditions and notice requirements for the increase.
